title: Refactor into modules
intro: `/home/coder/lab` manages a VPC, two subnets and a security group in one flat file; everything is applied. The platform team publishes a security group module as a Git repository at `/home/coder/repos/web-sg` with the tags `v1.0.0` and `v1.1.0` (see its README). **No resource may be destroyed or recreated in this lab.** Open a terminal via **☰ → Terminal → New Terminal**.

tasks.text: Move the VPC and the subnets into a local module in `modules/network`, called as `module.network`. Inside the module, name them `aws_vpc.this` and `aws_subnet.this`. The module takes `cidr_block` and `subnet_cidrs` and outputs `vpc_id` and `subnet_ids`.
Inside the module, create the subnets with `for_each` keyed by CIDR instead of `count`, e.g. `module.network.aws_subnet.this["10.0.1.0/24"]`.

Replace `aws_security_group.web` with the platform module as `module.web_sg`, using the Git source `git::file:///home/coder/repos/web-sg` pinned to the version that lets you keep the existing description.
Finish clean: `terraform plan` reports no changes.
